description: Measured history for one airport, not live offers: the usual total for the person's dates split into rental, second-driver fee, cover and out-of-hours fee (deposit shown separately as a card hold), the suppliers that usually suit their needs with each requirement marked meets / unverified and its evidence (debit card, deposit limit, automatic, 7 seats, car size, cross-border - checked together, company by company), and the correctly dated search link. Use it for planning and needs checks: no fixed dates yet, 'what does it usually cost', 'which companies take a debit card'. When the person gives exact dates and wants a car, prices or to book, call search_rentals first (live offers they can book); add this only for a needs check the live offers do not answer.

age.description: Main driver's age in years (default 35). Under 25 or over 70 often costs more.

airport.description: Airport id, IATA code or name, e.g. 'faro', 'FAO', 'Faro Airport'

car_type.description: Car size; omit for every size.

cross_border.description: True if they will drive into another country.

debit_card.description: True if the driver has no credit card - only cars whose desk takes a debit card for the deposit.

dropoff_airport.description: Optional return airport (code or name) when it differs from the pick-up - a one-way hire. One-way fees are not measured: the live search shows them in each total

extra_driver.description: True if a second driver will drive - their fee is then in every total.

full_cover.description: True if they want DiscoverCars' Full Coverage priced in.

max_deposit.description: The most the person can have held as a deposit (0 = no deposit). A hard limit, checked supplier by supplier.

residence.description: Two-letter country of residence, e.g. GB

seven_seater.description: True if they need 7 or more seats.

name: recommend_rental
title: Recommend rental
